summary: Define optional typed client summary rows on the existing collection protocol.

replay.detail: No claim projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: No database schema changes. Client JSON schema and generated models add Summary and SummaryMachines resources and the summary collection name.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet rules changes.

compatibility.detail: The generated client vocabulary gains optional summary rows. Older clients preserve unknown resource compatibility. This contract definition alone installs no provider or source and does not advertise server availability; clients select optional collections using daemon capabilities.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal replacement restart.

manual.detail: No manual setup; consumers adopt optional resources with their generated clients.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes. Previous clients and ordinary collection names retain their existing behavior.
